apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.3  (November 2026)  THE MENU AND EVERY PAGE SCROLL; A CLEAR SEARCH SIGN
  - The left menu scrolls when the window is lower than the menu (on a laptop, or with bigger letters, the pages after
    ADMIN were cut off). The version line stays at the bottom.
  - Every page (Offering Slips to Settings & Audit) scrolls when the window is lower than the page: what was hidden at
    the bottom is reached with the scroll bar or the mouse wheel. A page that fits shows no scroll bar. (The Dashboard
    already scrolled.) A list or a text box under the mouse still scrolls itself.
  - The search box has a drawn magnifying glass (the 🔍 letter was tiny on Windows); clicking it searches too.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.43.9 - SAVED CERTIFICATES; SEND BY EMAIL
  - The left menu: Baptism & Dedication is now right before Documents.
  - Baptism & Dedication has a third tab, Saved certificates: every certificate file made (PDF, and Word files that can
    still be changed), newest first. Search finds a file by its name or by a name on the certificate; double-click (or
    View) opens it. "Saved certificates of this person" (Water Baptism / Child Dedication tabs) shows the files of the
    chosen person.
  - Email…: on Documents (the PDF of the document) and on Saved certificates. A new email opens with the file attached
    in Outlook / the computer's mail program (Mail on the Mac); or, with Gmail, a new Gmail email opens in the browser and
    the file is shown in its folder to drag in. Type who it is for and press Send there. No password is kept in the program.
